DESCRIPTION: Global naming conventions and templating parameters for the MAST pf_passive IDS. LOOPS lists every passive structure derived from mast.yml's pf_passive section. NAME is the short identifier; STEM is the full geometry path used by the GEOMETRY data source (matches mast.yml `stem:` fields verbatim).
_COMMENT_LOOPS: 17 MAST passive structures from mast.yml. MAST has no per-structure current measurement (mast.yml's coil_current is for pf_active, not pf_passive), so no CURRENT field is provided. coil_cases is a single bundled entry holding all PF coil cases together — mast.yml does not split it per coil.
